name: Watchdog loop and negative-constraint evaluation
logic_name: Preserve matching rejected-hypothesis evidence and reject degenerate near-duplicate thresholds

test_list.description: A newer matching failure does not hide a matching prior rejected-patch fingerprint.
Configuration cannot set a zero similarity cutoff that would classify disjoint steps as duplicates.
Distinct steps with no shared token shingles remain unmatched under a positive threshold.

inputs.name: recent_records
inputs.description: Oldest-first records with their outcome and sorted shingle sets.

inputs.name: watchdog_config
inputs.description: Externally supplied bounded loop, pressure, and similarity settings.

output_description: The selected matching step and its linked rejected hypothesis, or a construction error for a degenerate configuration.
